evidence: docs/design/webhooks-de-saida.md:24 "Hoje cada serviço que precisa avisar um cliente externo faz o POST por conta própria, sem retry e sem registro central."

Searched both diagrams for prose after them. Structurizr diagram (lines 50-105) is followed by line 107: "O serviço de entrega é o único componente novo com lógica. Ele lê do Kafka...". Mermaid sequence diagram (lines 111-136) is followed by line 138: "O serviço trata cada evento em ciclos. A cada ciclo ele registra a tentativa, faz o POST e grava o resultado...". No diagram lacks explanatory prose.

Searched the document and reply for actor-action assertions. Every one traces to the user's message: the delivery service consumes Kafka, persists attempts, signs with HMAC, retries and sends to the DLQ; the domain services publish events and stop doing the POST (this replaces their direct POST); the team builds and operates the service (the stated trade-off against SaaS); support reveals failures ("a gente só descobre pelo suporte"). The glossary line "O cliente recalcula a assinatura" is a general definition of HMAC verification, not a claim about a specific actor's behavior. Unknowns such as who consumes the DLQ, who generates the secret and who the reviewers are appear only as open questions.
